changes: Exposed retained connection errors through the shared C++/Blueprint session API.
Added explicit reconnect flows to the actual C++ sample and serialized Blueprint graph.
Added fixture-scoped HTTPS/relay interruptions, responsive failure observation, fresh-channel checks and native cleanup validation.
limitations: Physical iOS acceptance remains deferred; these iOS runs use the ARM64 simulator.
Controlled local HTTPS/TURN UDP outages and explicit reconnect only; no Wi-Fi/cellular handover, ICE restart, Internet NAT or automatic retry claim.
Foreground/background behavior and broader packaged ordering/reliability, limits/backpressure checks remain open.
Development package sizes are absolute sizes, not Shipping download sizes or measured RTC deltas.

direct-Android-lifecycle-regression.ice_route: network interfaces; adb reverse carries HTTP only
